hints.shared: All agents use the same access of the organisation (a shared connector).
hints.personal: The server acts on behalf of the person who asks an agent: each person connects their own access under "My connections".

remote.blocked: Blocked: the address is not allowed (private network, or a redirect there). The operator can allow hosts in HERD_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
remote.timeout: Timeout: the server did not answer in time.
remote.unreachable: Unreachable: no connection to the server.
remote.unauthorized: Refused: the access is missing or invalid.
remote.forbidden: Refused: the access is not enough for this server.
remote.not_found: Not found: no MCP server answers at this address.
remote.rate_limited: Too many requests: the server asks for a pause.
remote.redirect: The server redirects; redirects are not followed.
remote.too_large: The server's answer is too large.
remote.protocol_error: The server does not speak valid MCP over Streamable HTTP.
remote.secret_unavailable: The stored access cannot be used now (key or environment variable missing).

servers.description: External MCP servers as a source of tools for agents. Every tool is approved one by one and classified as reading or writing.
servers.empty: No MCP server set up yet.

create.title: Add an MCP server
create.description: Streamable HTTP over https only. Its tool list is read when it is added; every tool then waits for your approval.

servers.urlHint: The address of the MCP endpoint, e.g. https://example.com/mcp.
servers.urlWithdraws: A new address withdraws every approval: each tool must be approved again afterwards.
servers.dataLocationHint: Where a call's data goes. A space's AI policy decides by it whether a run may call this server.
servers.noConnectors: No shared connector yet: create one under "Connectors" first.
servers.oauthClientHint: Which OAuth app people connect with. Without one, each person stores a token of their own.
servers.deleteText: {{name}} is deleted with all its tools and approvals; personal access to this server goes with it. Agents can no longer use its tools.
servers.personalWithOAuth: People connect with the stored OAuth app.
servers.personalWithToken: People store a token of their own.

tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: Agents get approved tools only, and only those granted to them in the agent's tool grants.
tools.empty: The server has not reported any tools (yet). Read again or test the connection.
tools.noneOpen: Nothing open: every tool is decided.

means.read: Reading: from level 2, no release per call.
means.write: Writing (acts outside): level 4, every call only after the asking person releases exactly these arguments.

tools.hintReadOnly: The server marks it as read-only. That is the server’s own unbinding word: check for yourself that it only reads.
tools.hintNone: The server does not mark it as read-only.
tools.changedNote: Its description or input schema changed since it was approved. It is held back until approved again. Check the current version below.
tools.missingNote: The server no longer offers this tool; it cannot be approved.
tools.details: Description and input schema (from the server)
tools.loosenText: The server does not mark {{name}} as read-only. Reading tools run without a release per call. Confirm only if you are sure it changes nothing.

schemaProblem.schema_too_large: The input schema is too large to offer to a model (over 64 KiB, or its structure over 8,000 characters). The tool cannot be approved.
schemaProblem.schema_unsupported: The input schema cannot be offered to a model (nested too deep, or a field name with characters other than letters, digits, _ . -). The tool cannot be approved.

connectors.title: Shared connectors
connectors.description: The organisation's stored access to external servers: a token, a key in a header of its own, or OAuth. Secrets are only ever written, never shown.
connectors.secretNote: A key is stored encrypted and never shown again.

kindHints.bearer: An API key or personal access token, sent as Authorization: Bearer.
kindHints.header: A key in a header with a name of its own, e.g. X-Api-Key.
kindHints.oauth: Sign-in at the provider with an OAuth app; connect afterwards.

connectors.headerNameHint: The name only, e.g. X-Api-Key. Protocol headers such as Host or Content-Type are not allowed.
connectors.oauthClientHint: The app the connector signs in with at the provider.
connectors.noClients: No OAuth app yet: create one below under "OAuth apps" first.
connectors.keyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
connectors.keyEnvHint: The name of a server environment variable starting with HERD_AI_.
connectors.unsafeAddress: The provider's sign-in address is not an https address; it is not opened.

deleteText.shared: {{name}} is deleted. A server that uses it must be switched to another access first.
deleteText.personal: Your access {{name}} is deleted. Agents can then no longer use this server for you.

clients.title: OAuth apps
clients.hint: Apps registered at a provider (e.g. a GitHub or GitLab application). OAuth connectors and personal servers sign in with them. The catalogue creates them by itself.

create.title: Create OAuth app
create.description: Enter this as the redirect address at the provider: <HERD_PUBLIC_URL>/api/ai/oauth/callback.

clients.discoverHint: Reads the server's OAuth details and fills in empty fields (nothing is stored).
clients.discovered: Details found and filled in. PKCE: {{pkce}}.

discovery.blocked: Blocked: the address is not allowed.
discovery.no_metadata: The server names no OAuth details; please enter them by hand.
discovery.resource_mismatch: The server's details do not match its address.
discovery.no_authorization_server: The server names no authorization server.
discovery.invalid_metadata: The authorization server's details are invalid.

fields.name: Name
fields.tokenAuth: How the client secret is sent

clients.resourceHint: Optional: the address of the server the token is meant for (RFC 8707).
clients.deleteText: {{name}} is deleted. This is not possible while a connector or server uses it.

catalog.description: Templates for external servers, shipped and from the operator's directory. A template only suggests: every tool is still approved one by one.
catalog.suggestions_one: Suggests the classification of {{count}} tool ({{writes}} writing).
catalog.suggestions_other: Suggests the classification of {{count}} tools ({{writes}} writing).

problems.title: Catalogue files with errors
problems.hint: These files were not read. The operator can fix them; the rest of the catalogue applies.

install.title: Set up {{name}}
install.description: Creates the server and reads its tools. Then you approve each tool on the server's page.
install.personalToken: Each person stores their own token under "My connections".

my.title: My connections
my.description: External servers that act on your behalf. Agents you ask use your own access for them; no one else sees or uses it, not even an admin.
my.listLabel: Servers that act on your behalf
my.empty: No server asks for personal access.
my.othersHint: Access to servers that are switched off or removed at the moment.

connected.title: Connected
connected.text: The sign-in at the provider worked. Agents can use the access now.

denied.title: Not connected
denied.text: The sign-in was declined or cancelled at the provider. You can try again.

failed.title: Connecting failed
failed.text: The provider did not confirm the sign-in. Try again; if that does not help, an admin checks the OAuth app.

invalid.title: Sign-in expired
invalid.text: This sign-in has expired or was already used. Please connect again.

connector.env_not_allowed: Personal access cannot use an environment variable.
connector.header_name_invalid: This header name is not allowed.
connector.in_use: A server uses this connector; switch it over first.
connector.name_taken: A connector already has this name.
connector.not_oauth: This is not an OAuth connector.
connector.oauth_client_invalid: This OAuth app does not exist.
connector.oauth_fixed: An OAuth connector's kind cannot be changed.
connector.oauth_unconfigured: OAuth is not set up: the operator must set HERD_PUBLIC_URL.
connector.server_invalid: This server does not take personal access.
connector.server_taken: You already have access for this server.

mcp_server.connector_invalid: Please choose a shared connector of the organisation.
mcp_server.name_taken: A server already has this name.
mcp_server.oauth_client_invalid: This OAuth app does not exist.
mcp_server.url_not_allowed: This address is not allowed: https only, no private network, no credentials or parameters in the address.

mcp_tool.loosen_unconfirmed: Please confirm that the tool only reads.
mcp_tool.missing: The server no longer offers this tool.

oauth_client.in_use: A connector or server uses this OAuth app.
oauth_client.name_taken: An OAuth app already has this name.
oauth_client.not_found: This OAuth app does not exist.
oauth_client.url_not_allowed: This address is not allowed (https only, no private network).
oauth_client.version_conflict: The OAuth app was changed meanwhile.

mcp_catalog.base_url_not_allowed: This instance address is not allowed.
mcp_catalog.install_invalid: These details do not fit the template.
